name: Orbit AI - Phase 5 - Demo extension inbound call lookup (W5.3, other half)

nodes.name: Telnyx demo line inbound webhook
nodes.notes: The TeXML/Call Control webhook_url configured on the shared TELNYX_DEMO_LINE_NUMBER's Telnyx application, hit once a caller has dialed in and entered an extension via DTMF gather (the gather step itself is Telnyx application config, not something this n8n workflow controls - it only receives the already-collected digits). UNVERIFIED payload shape: assumed {Digits: string} matching Telnyx's TeXML gather-result convention; if this account's app is Call Control (not TeXML), the equivalent is a 'call.dtmf.received' Call Control webhook event instead, with a different payload shape entirely - same 'flagged uncertain against a live account, not exercised against one' caveat as every Stripe/Telnyx integration point in this repo.

nodes.name: Fetch Location by extension
nodes.notes: The lookup half of W5.3 - resolves the dialed extension (written by demo-extension-auto-assign.workflow.json) back to the Location it belongs to.

nodes.name: Respond: play demo (NOT BUILT)

parameters.responseBody: <Response><Say>Thanks for calling. We found your demo, but the live voice connection isn't built yet - a human will follow up shortly.</Say><Hangup/></Response>

nodes.notes: HONEST GAP, not guessed at: this workflow can correctly identify WHICH Location's demo was requested, but actually connecting the caller to a live, real-time conversational voice experience of that Location's AI receptionist (using its unifiedKb) needs a live voice-AI pipeline - real-time speech-to-text, an LLM turn loop grounded in the unifiedKb, and text-to-speech, bridged onto this same Telnyx call leg - that doesn't exist anywhere in this repo. src/server/'s /generate-demo produces a unifiedKb (a knowledge-base object) and a web/chat demo, not a phone-callable voice agent. Building a fake version of that bridge here would be worse than the honest placeholder TeXML response above (a real, valid TeXML document that speaks a truthful message and hangs up, not a broken/silent call). This is the single largest deferred piece of W5.3 - same treatment as Front Door Audit's unscored 10 categories: named by the brief's outcome, not a decided mechanism, so not invented here.

parameters.responseBody: <Response><Say>Sorry, that extension wasn't recognized. Please check the extension number and try again.</Say><Hangup/></Response>
